hotel.name: JW Marriott Essex House New York

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Central Park South.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make our Essex House your home on Central Park South.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is an Art Deco luxury hotel in Midtown Manhattan.
verified_facts.excerpt: This Art Deco luxury hotel in Midtown Manhattan

verified_facts.text: The hotel has been classified as a New York Historical Hotel since 1931.
verified_facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Essex House has been classified as a New York Historical Hotel since 1931.

verified_facts.text: The Essex House rooftop sign was installed in 1932 and has become a fixture of the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooftop sign was installed in 1932 and has since become a fixture of the city skyline

verified_facts.text: Original ornate brass elevator doors, crystal lamps and chandeliers reflect the glamour of the Art Deco era.
verified_facts.excerpt: original ornate brass elevator doors, crystal lamps and chandeliers found throughout the hotel all reflect the glamour of the fashionable Art Deco era

verified_facts.text: Central Park and the Central Park Zoo are just across the street from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Central Park and Central Park Zoo, just across the street from JW Marriott Essex House New York

verified_facts.text: The hotel is an easy walk from Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, Columbus Circle and Fifth Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: an easy walk from NYC hot spots like Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, Columbus Circle and Fifth Avenue

verified_facts.text: Rooms include plush bedding, marble bathrooms, minibars, work desks and Wi-Fi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our New York hotel rooms near Central Park include plush bedding, marble bathrooms, minibars, work desks, and Wi-Fi.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations feature Art Deco designs and views of Central Park and the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: boast Art Deco designs, a variety of connecting room combinations, and luxury amenities such as plush bedding, marble bathrooms, and views of Central Park and NYC

verified_facts.text: Each suite in the Central Park Suite Collection tells a distinct story through design and artwork inspired by personalities who shaped New York's cultural landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each fully reimagined suite tells a distinct story through design, artwork, and other touches inspired by personalities who helped shape the cultural landscape of New York City.

verified_facts.text: The Promenade Suite is a two-bedroom suite on the 38th floor with panoramic Central Park views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 38th floor, this two-bedroom suite features panoramic Central Park views

verified_facts.text: The Delacorte Presidential Suite honors George T. Delacorte, founder of Dell Publishing.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Delacorte Presidential Suite honors George T. Delacorte, founder of Dell Publishing

verified_facts.text: The Meadow Terrace Suite has terrace views overlooking Central Park's Sheep Meadow.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gracious terrace views overlooking Central Park's Sheep Meadow

verified_facts.text: The Artisans Terrace Suite has a wraparound terrace and private contrast therapy with a cold plunge and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Highlights include a wraparound terrace, kitchenette with service entry, and private terrace contrast therapy with cold plunge and sauna.

verified_facts.text: The Artisans Terrace Suite's design nods to Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, with a piano key installation and a hand-painted mural.
verified_facts.excerpt: Design nods to Gershwin’s “Rhapsody in Blue,” with a piano key installation and vibrant hand-painted mural.

verified_facts.text: PRIMP Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments in a Fitness Center treatment room, plus in-room spa services.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax with massages, facials, and body treatments in our Fitness Center treatment room or enjoy the convenience of luxurious in-room spa services.

verified_facts.text: Guides from City Running Tours lead guests on a run through Central Park, covering its history, culture and architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn about the history, culture, and architecture of Central Park as the guides from City Running Tours lead Essex House guests and residents through an invigorating run.

verified_facts.text: The Central Park running tour is complimentary for hotel guests on Saturdays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary for hotel guests on Saturdays at 7:30am.

verified_facts.text: Bourbon Steak New York is Chef Michael Mina's restaurant at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Welcome to Bourbon Steak New York by Chef Michael Mina.

verified_facts.text: The bar overlooks Central Park South.
verified_facts.excerpt: an exquisitely crafted cocktail at the bar overlooking Central Park South

verified_facts.text: A JW Marriott partnership with Flamingo Estate greets arriving guests with an herbaceous scent and an immersive soundscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: with an herbaceous, uplifting scent and immersive soundscape setting a calming tone

verified_facts.text: Stays can be tailored by the hotel's Clefs d'Or concierge team.
verified_facts.excerpt: every stay can be tailored by our expert Clefs d'Or concierge team

verified_facts.text: Families can book connecting rooms with games and toys and an exclusive American Girl store experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: From connecting rooms with games and toys to an exclusive American Girl® store experience

verified_facts.text: Select rooms and suites offer views of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.
verified_facts.excerpt: experience a once-in-a-lifetime view of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade from select hotel rooms and suites

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym and Peloton bikes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Technogym® and Peloton Bikes
